description_en: Deletes all custom rule libraries available for audit under the user account. This operation is irreversible. To archive rule libraries, use the DownloadAuditNote API to save them before deletion
description_zh: 删除用户账户下所有可供审核使用的自定义规则库。删除后无法找回，如果您有对规则库存档的需求，请预先使用 DownloadAuditNote 接口保存需要的规则库
kebab_example: aliyun aimiaobi delete-audit-note --workspace-id llm-xx --note-id example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteAuditNote
